necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia. To accurately characterize the frequency and duration of these arrhythmic events for optimal management, a mobile cardiac telemetry study is ordered. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93229 despite the denial based on Reason Code CO-197.
